description_html:
Key Features

  • Deep Underground Location: Situated at a depth of 45 metres below grade, offering a secure and stable environment for specialized industrial or research activities.
  • Spacious Floor Area: Provides 504 square metres of usable space, ideal for accommodating equipment, machinery, or group operations.
  • High Occupancy Capacity: Designed to safely support up to 39 people per session, suitable for teams, training exercises, or collaborative projects.
  • Extended Session Duration: Allows for sessions of up to 10 hours, meeting the needs of long-term operations or experiments without interruption.
  • Secure Access Route: Entry provided via a hoist cage, ensuring safe and efficient transport of personnel and materials between surface and gallery.
  • Flexible Session Fee: Pricing is determined after acceptance, allowing for customized budgeting based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Safety and Stability: The underground setting enhances safety, providing protection from external environmental factors and offering stable conditions for sensitive work.
  • Versatile Space Utilization: The large, open floor plan supports a wide range of uses, from industrial machinery installation to group training or research activities.
  • Efficient Team Accommodation: High occupancy rating enables larger teams to work together efficiently, optimizing productivity and collaboration.
  • Long Operational Windows: Extended session times reduce downtime and increase operational efficiency for activities requiring continuous focus.
  • Reliable and Controlled Access: The hoist cage system ensures reliable, secure entry and exit, addressing common concerns about underground facility accessibility.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Industrial Testing and Equipment Storage: Ideal for companies seeking a secure, spacious environment for machinery testing, calibration, or storage below ground.
  • Research and Development Projects: Supports scientific studies or engineering projects that benefit from controlled underground conditions and extended work periods.
  • Group Training or Safety Drills: Suitable for organizations conducting safety drills, rescue training, or educational sessions requiring realistic underground settings.
  • Specialized Event Hosting: Can be used for workshops, technical demonstrations, or team-building exercises where unique, secure environments are required.

This drift-level machine gallery is designed to meet the needs of professionals seeking a secure, spacious, and accessible underground facility. Its combination of deep location, large floor area, high occupancy, and extended session capability addresses key requirements for industrial, research, and training applications.
